name: Kuzunoha Kagura
source:
A veteran officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. Shikigami [url=https://vndb.org/c108512]Unaki[/url], with whom she has grown up since early childhood, is like a family to her. Nonetheless, from the outside, that treatment may appear harsh.

She is an extravagant person who fiercely conceals her feelings and thoughts about her comrades. She believes [url=https://vndb.org/c99109]Kanade[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c99107]Kotetsu[/url], and [url=https://vndb.org/c99108]Isana[/url] to be particularly troublesome juniors, but she nevertheless looks after them properly. Kagura is a little high-handed towards [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]Ayato[/url], the second division chief, but this is due to her desire to show him, whom she loves and respects, her good sides. She frequently gets worked up about her inability to be honest. [url=https://vndb.org/c108514]Kaguya[/url], her little sister, is a serious but somewhat awkward young lady. She is prone to worry, but although Kagura is making her do so all the time, they are wonderful sisters.

As a Special Holder, she has the power of youko. She uses fox shikigami and spiritist amulet practices. Kagura with shikigami [url=https://vndb.org/c108512]Unaki[/url], who has the ability to comprehend the speech of people with ego, greatly assists the second division in combat by performing a variety of tasks such as scouting and surprise attacks.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/product/yuzuriha/chara04.html]official site[/url]]
